teaching.audioText: Welcome, everyone. Today's agenda has three points: the tasks, the deadline and the budget.

teaching.en: In this meeting, Carlos will be in charge of the tools, and I'd like Sara to look after the schedule.
teaching.es: En esta reunión, Carlos se encargará de las herramientas y me gustaría que Sara cuidara del horario.
teaching.explanationEs: Reparto con will be in charge of e I'd like + persona + to + verbo base.
segments: In this meeting, Carlos will be in charge of the
tools, and I'd like Sara to look after the schedule.
teaching.audioText: In this meeting, Carlos will be in charge of the tools, and I'd like Sara to look after the schedule.

teaching.en: Thanks for raising that objection, Leo. That's a fair point.
teaching.es: Gracias por plantear esa objeción, Leo. Es un punto razonable.
teaching.explanationEs: Reconoces la objeción antes de responder: fair point.
segments: Thanks for raising that objection,
Leo. That's a fair point.
teaching.audioText: Thanks for raising that objection, Leo. That's a fair point.

teaching.en: I hear your objection, but let's move on, and we can come back to it at the end of the meeting.
teaching.es: Oigo tu objeción, pero sigamos adelante y podemos volver a ella al final de la reunión.
teaching.explanationEs: Move on pasa al siguiente punto sin cerrar la puerta a la objeción.
segments: I hear your objection, but let's move on, and we can
come back to it at the end of the meeting.
teaching.audioText: I hear your objection, but let's move on, and we can come back to it at the end of the meeting.

teaching.en: To sum up, Carlos brings the tools, Sara makes the schedule, and the deadline is Friday. Any questions?
teaching.es: Para resumir, Carlos trae las herramientas, Sara hace el horario y la fecha límite es el viernes. ¿Alguna pregunta?
teaching.explanationEs: To sum up abre el resumen final; any questions invita a participar.
segments: To sum up, Carlos brings the tools, Sara makes
the schedule, and the deadline is Friday. Any questions?
teaching.audioText: To sum up, Carlos brings the tools, Sara makes the schedule, and the deadline is Friday. Any questions?

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me gustaría que Carlos organice el puesto.»

answer.text: I'd like Carlos to organise the stall

feedback.es: I'd like + persona + to + verbo base sirve para repartir una tarea con educación.

hint.es: Tras I'd like va la persona y luego to.

prompt.es: Completa: «Para resumir, la fecha límite es el viernes.»

feedback.es: To sum up abre el resumen final de la reunión; resume significa «reanudar».

hint.es: Es la expresión fija del resumen; no se dice resume.

origin.text: To ___ up, the deadline is Friday.

prompt.es: ¿Cómo respondes bien a esta objeción de Leo?

choices.text: That's a fair point. Could Mia cover Thursdays instead?
That's not my problem. You must come.

feedback.es: Se reconoce la objeción y se propone una solución. Las otras respuestas son una orden y una evasiva.

hint.es: La mejor respuesta reconoce la objeción y propone algo.

origin.text: Leo: "I can't come on Thursdays because I work late."

prompt.es: Escucha y elige el segundo punto de la agenda.

feedback.es: El segundo punto es el presupuesto, es decir, el dinero del proyecto. Las tareas son el primero y los carteles el tercero.

origin.audio: Today's agenda has three points. First, the tasks. Second, the budget. Third, the deadline for the posters.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con el momento de la reunión.

pairs: I'd like Mia to call the shop.
I hear your objection, but let's move on.
To sum up, the deadline is Friday.

feedback.es: Cada frase corresponde a un momento: abrir, repartir, responder a una objeción o resumir.

pairs: I'd like Mia to call the shop.
I hear your objection, but let's move on.
To sum up, the deadline is Friday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Gracias por plantear esa objeción; es un punto razonable.»

feedback.es: Fair point reconoce que la objeción tiene razón antes de responder.

origin.text: Thanks for raising that objection. That's a ___ point.

prompt.es: Según la propuesta de Sara, ¿cuál es el coste aproximado del rincón de lectura?

feedback.es: Los libros cuestan 120 y las estanterías 60: 180 libras. Las 200 libras son el objetivo para reunir, no el coste.

origin.text: Sara's pitch: Our goal is to raise £200 for a reading corner. The books cost £120 and the shelves cost £60. I'll ask Leo to build the shelves.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué tarea le toca a Carlos.

choices.text: Getting the neighbours to bring some chairs.
Calling the shop about the paint.

feedback.es: Carlos pedirá a los vecinos que traigan sillas; Sara es quien llama a la tienda.

origin.audio: Thanks, Tom, that's a fair point. Sara will call the shop today, and Carlos will ask the neighbours to bring chairs. The deadline is Friday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Me gustaría que Mia llame a la tienda» y «Leo es responsable del horario».

feedback.es: I'd like + persona + to + verbo base para delegar, y responsible for para nombrar a quien responde de algo.

sentences: I'd like Mia ___ call the shop.

prompt.es: Dirige el cierre (unas 55 palabras): objeción, tres tareas y resumen.

answer.text: Thanks for raising that, Tom. That's a fair point, so I'll ask Carlos to bring the table instead. I'd like Sara to call the shop, and I'll encourage Mia to make the poster. To sum up, Carlos brings the table, Sara calls the shop, Mia makes the poster, and the deadline is Friday. Any questions?
accepted: Thanks for raising that, Tom. That's a fair point, so I'll ask Carlos to bring the table instead. I'd like Sara to call the shop, and I'll encourage Mia to make the poster. To sum up, Carlos brings the table, Sara calls the shop, Mia makes the poster, and the deadline is Friday. Any questions?

I see your point, Tom. Carlos will bring the table instead. I'd like Sara to call the shop, and I'll encourage Mia to make the poster. To sum up, Carlos brings the table, Sara calls the shop, Mia makes the poster, and everything must be ready by Friday.
That's a fair point, Tom. I'll ask Carlos to bring the table. I'll tell Sara to call the shop, and I'll ask Mia to make the poster. To sum up, the deadline is Friday. Any questions?

feedback.es: El cierre reconoce la objeción, reparte tres tareas con ask, I'd like o encourage y resume con to sum up y la fecha límite.

origin.text: Tom dice que no puede traer la mesa el sábado. Tú diriges la reunión y escribes unas 55 palabras: reconoce su objeción, pide a Carlos que traiga la mesa, reparte otras dos tareas (Sara llama a la tienda; animas a Mia a hacer el cartel) y resume con la fecha límite del viernes.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase está bien construida para repartir una tarea?

choices.text: I'd like that Leo paints the sign.
I'd like Leo to paint the sign.
I'd like Leo paint the sign.

feedback.es: I'd like + persona + to + verbo base. Con that o sin to la estructura no es correcta.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Gracias por plantear esa objeción, pasemos al presupuesto.»

answer.text: Thanks for raising that objection let's move on to the budget

feedback.es: Se reconoce la objeción y se pasa al siguiente punto con move on.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué tarea hace la persona que habla.

feedback.es: La persona que habla dice «I will call the school». Mia trae las bebidas y Tom hace el cartel.

origin.audio: Before we finish: Mia will bring the drinks, Tom will make the poster, and I will call the school. The deadline is next Friday.
